```{r}
#| label: libraries

library(tidyverse)
library(glue)
library(fs)

```

```{r}
#| label: download-functions

paris_api_prefix <- "https://opendata.paris.fr/api/explore/v2.1/catalog/datasets/{dataset}/"
paris_api_export <- paste0(paris_api_prefix, "exports/{format}")
paris_api_attachement <- paste0(paris_api_prefix, "attachments/{att}")

dl_parquet <- function(dataset, filename, path) {
  if (!file_exists(path)) {
    message("Downloading ", filename)
    download.file(glue(paris_api_export, dataset = dataset, format = "parquet"), path, mode = "wb")
  }
}

dl_excel <- function(dataset, attachement, filename, path) {
  if (!file_exists(path)) {
    message("Downloading ", filename)
    download.file(glue(paris_api_attachement, dataset = dataset, att = attachement), path, mode = "wb")
  }
}

```


```{r}
#| label: download

if (!dir_exists("DATA")) {
  message("Creating directory DATA in ", getwd())
  dir_create("DATA")
}

parquets <- tribble(
  ~dataset,                                  ~filename,
  "elections-presidentielles-2007-1ertour",  "pres_2007_1",
  "elections-presidentielles-2007-2emetour", "pres_2007_2",
  "elections-presidentielles-2017-1ertour",  "pres_2017_1",
  "elections-presidentielles-2017-2emetour", "pres_2017_2",
  "elections-presidentielles2022-1ertour",   "pres_2022_1",
  "elections-presidentielles-2022-2emetour", "pres_2022_2",
  "elections-europeennes-2014",              "euro_2014",
  "elections-europeennes-2024",              "euro_2024",
  ) |>
  mutate(path = fs::path("DATA", filename, ext = "parquet"))

pwalk(parquets, dl_parquet)

pad2 <- function(i) str_pad(i, 2, pad='0')

excels <- tribble(
```
